summary: The current suggestion for India is to hold cash and wait, though Hindustan Copper is noted as a favorite if buying; for the US, the pick is JPMorgan Chase. Analysts are debating whether copper and cable companies like Hindustan Copper and Finolex Cables are good ways to bet on electric vehicles and power grids. They are also discussing how high fees and taxes on small amounts make it very hard to grow money quickly with bank stocks like JPMorgan Chase or State Bank of India.
